title: Santa Clara County Fairgrounds

services.name: Martial arts class
services.desc: Get ready for an action-packed day on the mats as the NAGA San Jose Grappling & BJJ Championship comes to the Santa Clara County Fairgrounds! The North American Grappling Association (NAGA) brings together grapplers and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu competitors of all ages and experience levels for an exciting day of competition. Athletes can compete in both No-Gi and Gi (BJJ) divisions, with categories available for children, teens, adults, masters, and experienced competitors. Whether you’re stepping onto the mats to compete, supporting your team, or coming to watch the action, this championship is a great opportunity to experience the energy, skill, and competitive spirit of the grappling
